definitions.explanation: A feeling of calm and emotional ease. The noun form derived from the verb 安らぐ (to feel at ease). Describes the soothing quality of a place, person, or experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安|やす}らぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{安|やす}らぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: This park provides a sense of tranquility in the middle of the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安|やす}らぎだ。
examples.english: Time spent with family is the greatest source of comfort.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb ⟦{安|やす}らぐ→安らぐ：07833_yasuragu⟧ (to feel at ease). Frequently used in advertising and lifestyle contexts to evoke a sense of relaxation and emotional peace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安|やす}らぎ: peace of mind
- {安|やす}らぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel tranquility
- {安|やす}らぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give comfort
- {安|やす}らぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧: a tranquil space

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧ emphasizes healing or recovery from stress, while {安|やす}らぎ focuses on the calm, settled feeling itself.
